reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every natural number n with 3 ≤ n and every real number κ with 4 ≤ κ, let E be real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard ℓ2 norm and coordinates indexed by Fin n = {0, …, n−1}. Let G be the full real orthogonal group O(n), with both determinant signs and its matrix Borel structure, and let μ be Measure.haarMeasure(⊤ : PositiveCompacts G), the canonical normalized Haar probability measure on that full group. Set
s = √κ,
r = (1 − 1/n)((s − 1)/(s + 1)),
ℓ = (4ns + (s − 1)²)/(8n(n − 1)),
with n interpreted as a real number in these expressions.

For each O ∈ G, identify O with its real n by n matrix and define
A_O = ((κ + 1)/2) I − ((κ − 1)/4)(O + Oᵀ).
Let γ_O be the existing multivariateGaussian measure with mean 0 ∈ E and covariance argument A_O⁻¹. This means exactly the pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by z ↦ Matrix.toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt(A_O⁻¹)) z; matrix inverse is the nonsingular matrix inverse in the approved definition context. Define the real function p_O on E by
p_O(x) = √(det A_O)/(2π)^(n/2) · exp(−(x · (A_O x))/2),
where x · (A_O x) is the coordinate dot product of WithLp.ofLp x with A_O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x. Also define
t(x) = exp(−ℓ ‖x‖²)
and the real number
v = ((−1)^n/n) ((s − 1)/(s + 1))^n (1 − 1/n)^(n/2)/(1 − r²).

Both real-valued functions on G,
O ↦ det(O) · (∫_E t(x) dγ_O(x))
and
O ↦ det(O) · (∫_E t(x)p_O(x) dx),
are absolutely Bochner integrable with respect to μ. Here dx in the second inner integral is the standard Euclidean Lebesgue volume measure on E, and every displayed integral is a real Bochner integral. Moreover, the following two equalities each hold:
∫_G det(O) · (∫_E t(x) dγ_O(x)) dμ(O) = v,
∫_G det(O) · (∫_E t(x)p_O(x) dx) dμ(O) = v.

The exponents n in (−1)^n and ((s − 1)/(s + 1))^n are natural powers. Each exponent n/2 is real division and uses Real.rpow, defined for all real bases; each square has natural exponent 2. Real division and inverse retain their totalized Lean meaning. The two integrability conclusions concern the displayed functions of O; the statement does not separately assert integrability of any inner integrand. The function p_O and the measure γ_O retain their literal displayed definitions, with no additional density identification needed as a premise or added as a conclusion.

objects.E: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), standard real n-dimensional ℓ2 Euclidean space.
objects.G: Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, full O(n) including both determinant signs.
objects.mu: Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts G), canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.
objects.A_O: ((κ + 1)/2) • I − ((κ − 1)/4) • (O + O.transpose), a real matrix indexed by Fin n in both directions.
objects.gamma: G → Measure E, O ↦ ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : E) (A_O⁻¹). This is the specified existing Gaussian pushforward using CFC.sqrt of its covariance argument A_O⁻¹.
objects.p: G → E → ℝ, (O,x) ↦ Real.sqrt(det A_O)/(2*Real.pi)^((n : ℝ)/2) * Real.exp(−(WithLp.ofLp x ⬝ᵥ (A_O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x))/2).
objects.F: G → ℝ, O ↦ det(O)*(∫ x, t(x) ∂γ_O).
objects.H: G → ℝ, O ↦ det(O)*(∫ x, t(x)*p_O(x) ∂volume).

domains.O: Full real orthogonal group G = O(n).
domains.mu: Measure G, canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.
domains.inner_integrals: Real Bochner integrals on E: first under γ_O and second under the implicit default volume measure on E.
domains.outer_integrals: Real Bochner integrals on G under μ.

quantifiers: For every n : ℕ satisfying 3 ≤ n.
For every κ : ℝ satisfying 4 ≤ κ.
The definitions of γ and p assign their displayed objects to every O ∈ G; p and t are defined for every x ∈ E.
The two inner integrals bind x separately over E for each O. The two outer integrals bind O separately over G.
The two Integrable assertions each concern the whole corresponding function of O.
All named auxiliary parameters and functions are let-definitions, with no existentially chosen constants.

conclusion.first_integrability: Integrable F μ, genuine absolute real Bochner integrability of O ↦ det(O)*(∫ x, t(x) ∂γ_O).
conclusion.second_integrability: Integrable H μ, genuine absolute real Bochner integrability of O ↦ det(O)*(∫ x, t(x)*p_O(x) ∂volume).

scopes.group: All outer integrals and outer integrability assertions use full O(n), not a determinant-restricted subgroup.
scopes.determinant_weight: det(O) multiplies the scalar value of the inner integral in each outer integrand.
scopes.gaussian_argument: The covariance argument of the existing multivariateGaussian is A_O⁻¹. The approved definition is the pushforward by the linear map arising from CFC.sqrt(A_O⁻¹).
scopes.p_formula: The numerator is the real square root of det(A_O). The exponential uses the negative coordinate quadratic form divided by 2. The prefactor divides by (2π)^((n : ℝ)/2).
scopes.measures: The first inner integral uses γ_O. The second inner integral has no displayed measure annotation and therefore uses volume on E. Both outer integrals use μ.
scopes.powers: Natural exponent n on (−1) and on (s − 1)/(s + 1); real exponent (n : ℝ)/2 on 2π and on 1 − 1/(n : ℝ); natural exponent 2 on s − 1, r, and ‖x‖.
scopes.v_parenthesization: v is the product of (−1)^n/n, ((s − 1)/(s + 1))^n, and (1 − 1/n)^(n/2), all divided by (1 − r^2).
scopes.integrability_boundary: The stated integrability conclusions apply to the two outer functions of O. No separate inner-integrability assertion is added.
scopes.additional_assertions: No unlisted positivity, support, covariance, probability-density identification, or moment assertion is introduced as an assumption or an additional conclusion.
scopes.division: Real divisions, inverses, and rpow retain the totalized definitions from the approved context.

constant_dependencies.kappa: Universally quantified real parameter, at least 4.
constant_dependencies.r_ell_v: Explicitly determined by n and κ.
constant_dependencies.A_O_gamma_O_p_O: Explicitly determined by n, κ and O; p_O also takes x as its function argument.
constant_dependencies.t: Explicitly determined by n and κ and its argument x.
constant_dependencies.mu: Canonical normalized full-group Haar probability for O(n), determined by the group of dimension n.

read_actions.action: Read both permitted inputs in full with cat.
Read the same two input files as bytes in Python, parse their JSON, compute raw-file hashes, and construct these result files.

run_evidence.reconstruction_basis: Only the lean.statement and lean.approved_definition_context fields in the respective input packet; packet metadata is copied solely for provenance.
run_evidence.verification: Each reconstruction hash is computed from its exact UTF-8 text. Each run hash is computed over every other field in its result object using the recorded canonicalization convention. Output construction and hash checks are performed in memory, without reading any additional file.

decoder_run_hash_convention: UTF-8 SHA-256 of json.dumps(result with decoder_run_sha256 omitted, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")); all other top-level and nested fields are included, object keys are sorted, array order is preserved, and no terminal newline is included in the hashed bytes.
